value.answer: Hi, I'm interested in the Staff Engineer, Data Platform role at Silvermark Labs. With six years as a backend engineer at Northwind Robotics, I've built and scaled services handling 2M+ events daily using TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL—skills I’ve deepened over two years as an engineering lead at Vertex Logistics, where I led teams across critical product lines. I successfully led a nine-month migration from a monolith to an event-driven architecture with zero customer-visible downtime, reducing p99 latency from 1.9s to 340ms. My experience includes extensive PostgreSQL work in schema design, query tuning, and replication, along with deploying services using Kubernetes and Terraform. I’m confident this background aligns well with the data platform challenges at Silvermark Labs.
